title: Every man has one of
these 7 face shapes
hook: Every man has one of these seven face shapes. Here's how to spot yours.

baseFace.label: AI MODEL
baseFace.prompt: Photorealistic passport-style studio portrait of a fictional 25-year-old man (not a real person), square jaw, short dark wavy hair, neutral expression, looking straight at camera, face perfectly centered and frontal, head and shoulders, charcoal suit, white shirt, dark tie, plain flat dusty-sage green background, soft even frontal lighting, sharp focus, vertical 9:16, face occupies middle of frame with space above head
baseFace.morphPrompt: Edit this photo of a man. Give him {shape} This must be an obvious, dramatic change to the outline of his face. Everything else must stay identical so the two photos line up when overlaid: same man (same eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, hair, skin tone, neutral expression), same suit, shirt and tie, same head position, same head size, same camera framing and crop, same lighting, same plain sage-green background. Photorealistic studio portrait.

shapes.name: Oval
shapes.line: Oval. Slightly longer than wide, with a softly rounded jaw. The most balanced shape.
shapes.morph: a clearly OVAL face shape: the face slightly longer than it is wide, smooth balanced curves, gently rounded jaw, chin a little narrower than the forehead, no sharp angles

shapes.name: Oblong
shapes.line: Oblong. Long and narrow, with the forehead, cheeks and jaw all about the same width.
shapes.morph: a clearly OBLONG (long) face shape: a noticeably longer, narrower face with a longer lower face and chin, straight sides, forehead, cheekbones and jaw all about the same narrow width

shapes.name: Round
shapes.line: Round. Almost as wide as it is long, with full cheeks and a soft chin.
shapes.morph: a clearly ROUND face shape, an obvious change: the face as wide as it is long, full, soft, rounded cheeks, a short soft rounded chin, a soft jawline with no visible angles, slightly fuller face overall

shapes.name: Heart
shapes.line: Heart. A wide forehead that tapers down to a narrow, pointed chin.
shapes.morph: a clearly HEART-shaped face: a wide forehead and broad temples, the face tapering strongly down to a narrow, pointed chin, a slim jaw

shapes.name: Diamond
shapes.line: Diamond. The cheekbones are the widest point, with a narrow forehead and chin.
shapes.morph: a strongly DIAMOND face shape, exaggerated: very high, very wide, sharp, protruding cheekbones that are clearly the widest point of the face; a clearly narrower forehead and temples above them; hollow cheeks below; the face narrowing to a small, pointed chin, giving an angular diamond outline

shapes.name: Triangle
shapes.line: Triangle. A narrow forehead sitting on top of a wide, heavy jaw.
shapes.morph: a strongly TRIANGLE face shape, exaggerated: a clearly narrow forehead and temples, and a very wide, heavy, square, bulky jaw that sticks out past the cheekbones as by far the widest part of the face, with a broad flat chin — the face widens from top to bottom like a pyramid

shapes.name: Square
shapes.line: And square. Straight sides and sharp jaw corners. That's this guy's real shape.

cta: So which one are you? Drop your face shape in the comments.
